scope: Ordinary native Godot extension inheriting the existing r21 visual world; read-only comparison.
result: Preserve DESIGN.md and .impeccable/design.json. No durable design-system change is authorized or required for this extension.
components: 430px capped fluid shell, scrolling body, fixed bottom navigation, 48px controls, square borders, two-column portraits, three-column stats, affection bars, comparison and sale confirmation.
preexisting_drift: Durable documents describe r11 blue-white porcelain, Gowun Batang and rounded controls, while current r21 code uses paper/red/brush treatment.
implementation_difference: New panel display-font titles, flat primary fills and text navigation are simpler than town SVG titles, textured button and icon navigation.
